fact: Founded 2016, launched in the UAE on 1 Oct 2017; HQ in Dubai with a base in Saudi Arabia
Operates marketplace, food delivery and grocery in Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Egypt
Raised USD 500 m in Dec 2025 from backers including PIF and Mohamed Alabbar, ahead of a possible IPO
Acquired fashion platform Namshi from Emaar for AED 1.23 bn (USD 335 m); completed Feb 2023
Partnered with ADNOC Distribution (Apr 2025) to put noon Minutes hubs in service stations
Ecosystem includes noon Minutes, noon Food, noon Grocery and the noon One subscription
Return window: 15 days for eligible items; inspection 2–5 working days; refund can take 7–14 business days
Trustpilot TrustScore about 1.2 / 5 from ~5,000 reviews; replies to ~97–98% of negative reviews
